ViHateT5: Enhancing Hate Speech Detection in Vietnamese With a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer Model — Lacuna
They used a high-performing "AI Data Annotator" (a fine-tuned ViSoBERT model) to automatically label this massive corpus, creating the VOZ-HSD dataset. This domain-specific pre-training allows the model to learn the specific vocabulary and linguistic patterns of Vietnamese internet trolls before being fine-tuned for specific benchmarks.
